title: The agenda is too long for 30 minutes: a proposed order
detail: 19 items are open (13 decisions), 7 of them carried over from 2 November because nothing was recorded as decided at either stand-up; 15 of the 19 wait on Dinis. Proposed order: (1) what has a deadline today: the print order and sign-off (WS-48, WS-113 at 16:00), the first LinkedIn post (WS-126), the GitHub invitations (WS-09/WS-124); (2) who records the decisions (WS-107), so the rest get written down; (3) the other decisions, oldest first; (4) questions, ideas and syncs only if time is left (they carry over by themselves). One decision has no options or recommendation yet: the first five target companies (WS-25); its owners could bring them to the 18:00. Anything not reached carries over; the debrief at 13:40 lists it.

closed.why: Overtaken: replaced by the 4 November 13:00 brief item from the same agent.
